style.backgroundSystem: cream studio field #FAF6F1 and pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, pastel tinted panels #F5DDE0 / #DDF0E4 / #EAE4F5 for info shots, soft blurred autumn outdoor greenery for lifestyle

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kidswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream #FAF6F1, charcoal #2B2B2E, blush pink accent #F5DDE0 and mint secondary #DDF0E4; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no adult models or recognizable child faces
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment, consistent garment scale across the set, hanger-flat and on-body presentations share the same proportions
style.surfaceSystem: matte cream backdrop paper and light birch-toned flat surface
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif, single accent color per screen
